name: @morpheus/factory-host
description: Optional Factory host and fleet tooling: placement core, Xcode host updates, worker setup. Explicit setup only.

scripts.test: vitest run && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && node --test reporting/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: for f in worker/*.sh worker/setup/*.sh scripts/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done && python3 -m py_compile worker/*.py fleet/*.py scripts/*.py
